\caption[Airspace management internal block diagram, default level of detail]{Airspace management internal block diagram, default level of detail. ATC's decision support (decisionSupport : AtcDecisionSupport) is the En Route Decision Support Tool (EDST), the conflict probe in the en route automation (ERAM) that the sector controllers use (FAA JO 7110.65BB, para. 13-1-1). EDST predicts conflicts from track data, the current plan, aircraft performance and forecast winds (winds not drawn), and alerts the controller. Today EDST uses generic aircraft performance; the airline's performance share shown arriving at it is the proposed improvement, not part of today's system. View \texttt{airspaceManagementIbd}; source \texttt{nas\_ibd\_airspace\_management.sysml}; rendered 2026-11-24.}
\label{fig:sysml-airspaceManagementIbd}
\end{figure}
